_comment: Every agent edit is immediately verified: ruff --fix, then the pytest suite, then mypy, with output returned to the model in the same turn. PY points at the dedicated atlas-classifier conda env directly, avoiding a shell-init dependency; override it with ATLAS_CLASSIFIER_PYTHON.

hooks.command: PY="${ATLAS_CLASSIFIER_PYTHON:-/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base/envs/atlas-classifier/bin/python}"; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && { $PY -m ruff check src/ scripts/ tests/ --fix 2>&1 | tail -10; $PY -m pytest tests/ -x -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -30; $PY -m mypy src/ scripts/ --ignore-missing-imports --no-error-summary 2>&1 | tail -20; }
